## Base branch

Feature and agent work targets `develop`. Only `release/vX.Y.Z` and `hotfix/vX.Y.Z` target `main`.

## Contributor agreement

- [ ] I have signed the Pagefirst Contributor License Agreement (CLA.md): the CLA bot asks on a first pull request, and the maintainer and bots are exempt.

## Preview

Previews are off by default to stay under the Vercel deploy limit. Put `[preview]` in a commit message to build one.
